The main takeaway from our work is that

VTrack can provide accurate travel time estimation for a large fraction of the road network, even with a sparse set of GPS or WiFi samples, and can be used to provide accurate traffic information for a large fraction (up to 80%) of road segments.
, while GPS is the gold standard for location estimation, WiFi can provide accurate location estimates in the absence of GPS, and can do so with significantly less energy cost.
